prompt:

Arms connected clearly to their correct shoulder, natural elbows/wrists/fingers. Maintain hand ownership by rotating the actual body, NOT by flat mirroring. Do not grab teeth. One red motor housing with one complete cutting bar extending diagonally down SCREEN RIGHT. Restrained alert stance, no victim, injury effects or action impact.
Match source1 realistic finely painted game-asset textures, original muted palette, neutral even light, grounded two feet. Whole body, blade tip, head, fingers, apron hem and both shoes inside a broad canvas with clear transparent margin all around. True RGBA transparency, solid subject, no floor, shadow, fog, vignette, backdrop, text, labels, border, watermark or extra character. Static pose candidate, no animation.
